fields.v: Spec-first (extractor's classification in Böckeler terms; the authors do not use SDD terms). Authors' wording: a 'visible task contract' (spec.md and openapi.yaml) that is 'the single source of truth for construction and evaluation'; the 'contract-realization problem'
fields.quote: Each BACKENDFORGE task exposes a visible contract that is the single source of truth for construction and evaluation.
fields.why: The value attributes 'spec-first approach in Böckeler terms' to the authors' wording, but the paper never uses SDD or spec-first terms; the classification is the extractor's.
fields.doubt: O valor dá a entender que os autores usam o termo "spec-first", mas o artigo nunca usa termos de SDD; a classificação é tua. Separa a tua classificação das palavras dos autores (pág. 4, §3.2). O nível spec-first em si parece razoável.
